instruction: A candid full-shot photograph shows an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls. The man in the black polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) and the woman in the white patterned t-shirt (R2) are walking away from the camera side-by-side. The man has his right arm wrapped around the woman's shoulder as they walk. Overhead studio lights illuminate the room, casting soft shadows on the floor. The camera captures their movement from behind at eye-level.

R2 is the person whose shoulder is being held by R1
